_comment: Porter MCP server for Google Antigravity. HOW TO APPLY: merge only mcpServers.porter into ~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json or <workspace>/.agents/mcp_config.json; preserve other servers. Match serverUrl to your Porter instance and replace {{PORTER_TOKEN}} with a scoped Porter OAuth access token, not a model-provider key or client secret. Prefer memory.read.<tag>, adding memory.write only if needed. Official docs confirm Streamable HTTP serverUrl and headers.Authorization: https://antigravity.google/docs/mcp?tab=cli (reviewed 2026-10-23). No database credentials or server signing key are needed. Keep real tokens out of Git. UNVERIFIED: not tested against a live Antigravity install here.
